78	def add_inner_blocks(blocks):
79	    '''Process a list of blocks by adding all closures and inner classes as
80	    top-level blocks.
81	    '''
82	    new_blocks = []
83	    all_blocks = blocks[:]
84	    while all_blocks:
85	        block = all_blocks.pop()
86	        new_blocks.append(block)
87	        for inner_block in ('closures', 'inner_classes'):
88	            for i_block in getattr(block, inner_block, ()):
89	                named = i_block._replace(name=block.name + '.' + i_block.name)
90	                all_blocks.append(named)
91	                for meth in getattr(named, 'methods', ()):
92	                    m_named = meth._replace(classname=named.name)
93	                    all_blocks.append(m_named)
94	    return new_blocks
